newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet cargo spreads pressured by BA strike.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet cargo spreads pressured by BA strike.

text.p: NWE jet fuel cargo differentials remained under pressure on Thursday from a planned strike by British Airways cabin crew next week, traders said.
July loading cargoes were notionally assessed at July IPE +$15, 50 cents under Wednesday's trade.
Traders said buyers appeared to be holding off in the hope of even lower numbers before the 72-hour strike, which would slash BA's prompt requirements.
Barges were quiet and asssessed at around July IPE +$14/15. Front month July IPE gas oil closed down $3 a tonne at $164.50.
